title: Three steps in order
prompt: The robot's start-up has three steps. Write `step_one`, `step_two` and `step_three`, printing "one", "two" and "three". Call them from `run` so the words come out in that order.
hints: Calls run from top to bottom. The order you write the calls in run is the order things happen.
Three definitions, each `func step_x():` with one print.
In run: `step_one()`, then `step_two()`, then `step_three()`, one per line.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
